content.rendered:
Where: Middleton Elementary Playground

When: July 13th AND August 10th

Time: 5:00 – 6:00 pm

Join us for one OR both days to learn about school readiness, connect with other kinder families, and spend time with some of our amazing teachers. There will be free leaning activities, crafts and refreshments provided.
